label: ESP32-S3 Uno + ILI9488 parallel shield (hardware-verified)
note: Verified on hardware (control RST5/CS6/DC7/WR1/RD2). CRITICAL: LCD_D4=GPIO19 and LCD_D5=GPIO20 are the S3's native USB-Serial-JTAG lines. The display ONLY works under the Arduino build with 'USB CDC On Boot: Disabled' (console on UART0), which lets the sketch reclaim 19/20 as GPIO. MicroPython's REPL sits on those USB pins and can never drive this display.

label: Classic ESP32 'D1 R32' Uno + ILI9488 parallel shield
note: A D1 R32 maps the shield's LCD control lines (RST/CS/RS/WR/RD = A4/A3/A2/A1/A0) onto GPIO36/34/35/4/2. WARNING: GPIO34-36 are INPUT-ONLY on the classic ESP32 — if the panel stays white you must bodge CS/DC/RST to output-capable GPIOs. Verify with the Test Pattern before trusting this map.

label: Manual / custom pins
note: Blank starting point: edit every pin by hand in the Board / Pins card, push, and run the Test Pattern until the bars render. Save as a named board when it works so you never have to rediscover it.
